Summarize Model Fits

Source: R/auxiliary.R
summary.RiskMap.Rd

Provides a summary method for the "RiskMap" class that computes standard errors and confidence intervals for likelihood-based model fits

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap'
summary(object, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

An object of class "RiskMap" from glgpm

level

Confidence level for intervals (default 0.95).

...

Not used, and an error if given, so that a misspelt argument is not ignored.

Value

A list of class "summary.RiskMap" with parameter estimates, standard errors, and confidence intervals. For binomial, Poisson and negative binomial models, its component mcml reports certified Monte Carlo maximum likelihood: certificate (an approximate bound, with probability level, on the Monte Carlo error of the estimate in statistical standard errors, NA when there is none), tolerance, certified, outcome, correction_refused (whether the Newton correction of the last stage did not converge), stages, fitting_draws and validation_draws (at the last stage), certification_bank (the effective draws and Pareto shape of the certification draws), checks_to_review, the number of checks of check_fit that need a look, starting_values, where the starting values of the parameters not given in start_pars came from, "current" (RiskMap's defaults) or "transformed_gaussian" (a Gaussian fit to the transformed data, which glgpm() uses when the Laplace approximation of the likelihood prefers it to the defaults), or "user" when start_pars gives every parameter, starting_given, the names of those given in start_pars (absent when none was), and starting_reason, why the defaults were kept other than by being preferred in that comparison, such as "re_terms" when it is not made for a model with re() terms, "not_compared" when set_control_mcml(start_comparison = FALSE) skips it, "candidates_given" when start_pars gives every value the comparison could change, "transformed_failed" when the Gaussian fit failed, or "not_recorded" for a fit saved by an earlier version that did not record why (NULL when the comparison chose the start). mcml is NULL for Gaussian models. The parameters of the family, such as the measurement error variance of a Gaussian model, are in family_parameters, a table of those that were estimated, and held_family_parameters, a list of those held at a given value. The other parameters that fixed_pars holds keep their rows, with no interval, and held_parameters says at what values they are held (absent when none is).

Examples

data(italy_sim)

fit <- glgpm(
  formula = y ~ gp(),
  data = italy_sim[1:100,],
  family = "gaussian",
  messages = FALSE
)

summary(fit)
#> ── Linear geostatistical model ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> glgpm(formula = y ~ gp(), data = italy_sim[1:100, ], family = "gaussian",
#>     messages = FALSE)
#> The identity link.
#> The limits are those of 95% confidence intervals.
#> 
#> Regression coefficients
#>             Estimate Lower limit Upper limit   StdErr z.value   p.value    
#> (Intercept)  9.32340     7.70078    10.94603  0.82788  11.262 < 2.2e-16 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> 
#> Measurement error
#>                        Estimate Lower limit Upper limit
#> Measurement error var.  0.17859     0.13335      0.2392
#> 
#> Spatial Gaussian process, Matern correlation with kappa = 0.5
#>                          Estimate Lower limit Upper limit
#> Spatial process var.       4.8494      1.8196      12.924
#> Spatial corr. scale (km)  39.0150      2.7773     548.084
#> Variance of the nugget effect fixed at 0
#> 
#> Log-likelihood   8.618636
#> AIC             -9.237272
summary(fit, level = 0.98)
#> ── Linear geostatistical model ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> glgpm(formula = y ~ gp(), data = italy_sim[1:100, ], family = "gaussian",
#>     messages = FALSE)
#> The identity link.
#> The limits are those of 98% confidence intervals.
#> 
#> Regression coefficients
#>             Estimate Lower limit Upper limit   StdErr z.value   p.value    
#> (Intercept)  9.32340     7.39745    11.24935  0.82788  11.262 < 2.2e-16 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> 
#> Measurement error
#>                        Estimate Lower limit Upper limit
#> Measurement error var.  0.17859     0.12626      0.2526
#> 
#> Spatial Gaussian process, Matern correlation with kappa = 0.5
#>                          Estimate Lower limit Upper limit
#> Spatial process var.       4.8494      1.5150      15.523
#> Spatial corr. scale (km)  39.0150      1.6947     898.204
#> Variance of the nugget effect fixed at 0
#> 
#> Log-likelihood   8.618636
#> AIC             -9.237272
